title: Love at the String Scale: Tidal Deformability Across the Black Hole-String Transition
summary: Tidal deformability provides a sensitive probe of the structure of compact objects, and black holes are exceptional in having vanishing static Love numbers in four-dimensional Einstein gravity. We ask what happens to this fine-tuned rigidity across the black hole-string transition, where the same states are expected to admit a weakly coupled description as a self-gravitating highly excited string, or "string star".
